relevance_note: Case report of one patient with LAD-1 features and two CD18 mutations: "the patient is a compound heterozygote carrying the S138P and G273R mutations in his two CD18 alleles".
method_note: Single-patient case report (patient JT), read in full by hand; JSON assembled with a short script and every span checked verbatim against the Markdown. Gene is printed as CD18 (beta2 subunit), recorded as stated. Variants use legacy notation without 'c.'/'p.' prefixes (T412C/S138P, G817A/G273R); recorded verbatim in cdna/protein fields; no transcript printed. Variant type left 'not reported' because the authors say only 'point mutations' resulting in amino-acid changes, not a class. Synonymous polymorphisms C1111A (V367V) and C1323T (V441V) in Table 2 are described as not affecting amino acids and get no rows. Inheritance/parental testing not reported; phase of the mutations was inferred by the authors from clone counts (not parental testing). Vital status left 'not reported' (BMT in autumn 1997; 'survival into the midteen period' is not an explicit status at last report). The text describing late skin infections is split by Table 3 in the Markdown ('sustained skin' ... 'infections with lesions'), so two separate spans are given rather than joining them. 'intracellular killing of S. epidermidis was within normal' is likewise split by Table 2 before 'limits'. Necrotic skin item marked observed from 'surgery to remove necrotic tissue' at skin-infection sites. General LAD-1 statements in the abstract/introduction (impaired pus formation, etc.) are not about this patient and were not used. No contradictions found.
